<entry id="Q01844">
<head-word>פָּרַךְ</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to split, divide off</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Denom. (cmp. מְחִיצָה) פָּרוֹכֶת.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to split</italic> (grist &c.); 
<italic>to crush, rub, grind</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ber. 37
<sup>b</sup> פּוֹרְכָן, v. infra. Ex. R. s. 31 באחרונה אדם פּוֹרְכוֹ בידו וכ' at last (when silver has been worked over several times) one may crumble it in one’s hand, and it is no longer fit for any work. B. Mets. 89
<sup>b</sup> יִפְרוֹךְ Ms. R., v. infra; a. e.—Part. pass. פָּרוּךְ; 
<plural-form>pl. פְּרוּכִים, פְּרוּכִין</plural-form>. Midr. Till. to Ps. CXVIII, 10-13 (ref. to אמילם ib., v. מָלַל) והמה פ' and they were (shall be) crushed.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>פֵּרֵךְ, פֵּי'</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to split, demolish</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Yalk. Gen. 39, v. פָּכַר.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to crush, grind; to crack; to husk</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Men. 75
<sup>b</sup> מְפָרְכָן עד וכ' (Ber. 37
<sup>b</sup> פּוֹרְכָן) he crushes them until he has reduced them to the fineness of the flour of which they had been made. Bets. 12
<sup>b</sup> מְפָרְכִין קטניות וכ' you may husk peas on the Holy Day. Sabb. 53
<sup>b</sup> סכין ומפרכין לאדם וכ' Ar. a. early eds. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 70; ed. a. Mss. מפרכסין, v. פִּרְכֵּס I) you may oint a sore and scrape the scab off for a human being (on the Sabbath), but not for a beast; a. e.—[Ib. 155
<sup>b</sup> מפרכין תבן, v. פְּרַךְ II.]</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִפְרִיךְ</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> same, 
<italic>to smash, crack</italic> &c. B. Mets. 89
<sup>b</sup> לא יַפְרִיךְ … מַפְרִיךְ וכ' (Ms. R. יִפְרוֹךְ) the laborer must not smash fruits against a rock and eat them, but he may smash them one by one (with his hand) and eat; a. e.—[Yalk.</definition>
<notes> Gen. 130 מפריכין, read: מפרינין, v. פָּרַן.]</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִפְרָךְ</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be crumbled; to be cracked; to be scraped, peeled</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Bekh. 37
<sup>b</sup> יבישה כדי שתהא נִפְרֶכֶת a sore is called dry, when it can be scraped. Ḥull. 46
<sup>b</sup> כדי שתִּיפָּרֵךְ וכ' that it can be scraped off with the nail. Ber. 25
<sup>a</sup> כל זמן שזורקה ואינה נפרכת when he throws it down, and it is not crumbled. Pesik. R. s. 11 שנִיפְרָךְ, v. פֶּרֶךְ; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִתְפָּרֵךְ</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be crumbled, threshed</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. B. Mets. X, end, 12
<sup>c</sup> כדי שיִתְפָּרֵךְ ברגלו וכ' in order that it (the dung) be trodden down by the feet of men and beasts; (Bab. ib. 118
<sup>b</sup> שיהא נישוף; Tosef. ib. XI, 8 שיישוף).</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="Q01845">
<head-word>פְּרַךְ</head-word>
<hw-number>I</hw-number>
<language-key> ch. </language-key>
<language-reference>same</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, 
<italic>to break, smash, crumble.</italic></definition>
<notes>
<italic>—Part. pass</italic>. פְּרִיךְ, פְּרִיכָא 
<italic>crushed; peeling, brittle</italic>. Targ. Lam. IV, 8 (h. text יבש, v. Bekh. 37
<sup>b</sup>, quot. in preced.).—Lev. R. s. 8, beg., v. אַצִּיל. Pes. 68
<sup>b</sup> יבשה מִפְּרִיךְ פ' a dry wart is scraped 
<pgbrk id="pg1229" />off (and not cut). B. Mets. 70
<sup>a</sup> דהבא פ' broken gold-ware (gold dust); B. Bath. 166
<sup>a</sup>; a. fr.—Trnsf. 
<italic>to refute, raise an objection</italic>. B. Kam. 5
<sup>b</sup>, a. fr. דאיכא למִיפְרַךְ וכ' it may be objected (against this analogy) &c.; v. infra.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>פָּרֵךְ, פָּרֵיךְ</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> same.</definition>
<notes> [Targ. Koh. III, 3. v. פְּכַר.) Targ. Y. II Num. XXXIII, 52 תְּפָרְכוּן (not תתפ').—Y. Sabb. VII, 10
<sup>a</sup> bot. כד מְפָרֵךְ ברישייא when he husks the heads of garlic. Bets. 12
<sup>b</sup> מהו לפָרוּכֵי וכ' dare one husk by rubbing and eat the seeds?; a. e.—Trnsf. 
<italic>to refute, raise an objection</italic>. Kidd. 13
<sup>a</sup>, a. fr. פ' רב אחא וכ' Rab A. objected &c. Ned. 51
<sup>a</sup> כל … פָּרְכָהּ וכ' whatever interpretation of 
<italic>toʿebah</italic> Rabbi offered, Bar Ḳ. refuted it. Sot. 7
<sup>a</sup> ופָרְכוּהָ Rashi a. Tosaf. (ed. ופֵירְכוּהָ Hebr. form) and he refuted it. Pes. 69
<sup>a</sup>; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Ithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִתְפָּרַךְ, </binyan-form>
<binyan-name>Ithpe.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִיתְפְּרַךְ, אִיפְּרַךְ, </binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, אִיפְּרִיךְ 
<italic>to be crushed</italic>; 
<italic>to be dry, parched, easily peeled</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Is. XXIV, 7 (h. text אמלל'). Targ. Ps. XC, 5. Ib. LXXX, 17 מִיפַּרְכָא Ms. (ed. מופרכא, corr. acc.; ed. Wil. מְפָרְכָא Part. pass. 
<italic>Pa.</italic>; h. text כסוחה).—[Targ. Y. II Num. XXXIII, 52, v. supra.]—Sabb. 20
<sup>b</sup> אִיפָּרוּכֵי מִפָּרְכָן (or מְפָרְכָן) they are brittle (unfit to be twisted into wicks). Pes. 68
<sup>b</sup>, v. supra; a. e.—Trnsf. 
<italic>to be refuted</italic>. Hor. 14
<sup>a</sup> כל דאמר מילתא ולא מִיפְּרַךְ וכ' whoever will say something and not be refuted, let him be the chief; דכולהו אִיפְּרִיךְ וכ' what every one of them said was refuted, what A. said was not; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="Q01847">
<head-word>פֶּרֶךְ</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>

<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> (b. h.) 
<italic>tyranny, rigor</italic>, v. 
<xref rid="Q01807">פְּרִיכָה</xref>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Sot. V, 20
<sup>c</sup> top שהיו משעבדין בהן בפ' וכ' who had made them serve with rigor and hard labor. Ex. R. s. 5, a. e., v. פָּנוּי; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>that which is easily crushed, brittle shell, husk</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Orl. III, 7, a. fr. אגוזי פ' 
<italic>nuts with brittle shells, crack-nuts</italic>. Pesik. R. s. 11 האגוז יש בו ג' מינים אגוזי פ' וכ' there are three kinds of nuts: soft-shell nuts, middling nuts &c.; של פ' שניפרך מעצמו the 
<italic>perekh</italic> nut which bursts open of itself; כך הוא ישראל … מעצמם אלו של פ' so are the Israelites: those among them who do good of their own accord are the crack-nuts; Yalk. Cant. 992.—
<plural-form>Pl. פְּרָכִים, פְּרָכִין</plural-form>. R. Hash. 13
<sup>b</sup> עשויין פ' פ' they (the peas) are husked as you need them.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>pl.</italic> as ab.</definition>
<notes> [
<italic>crushers</italic>,] 
<italic>bars of a grate</italic> (through which the poking is done). Kel. XII, 3; Tosef. ib. B. Mets. II, 10.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="Q01862">
<head-word>פִּרְכֵּס</head-word>
<hw-number>I</hw-number>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (enlargement of פָּרַךְ) 
<italic>to rub, scrape</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. 53
<sup>b</sup>, v. פָּרַךְ.—Esp. 
<italic>to grind colors, rub with paint, paint</italic> (hair, skin); trnsf. 
<italic>to give a deceptive appearance to</italic>. Lam. R. to II, 1 והיו … מְפַרְכְּסִין בדם וכ' and the men of the country painted (themselves) with the blood of his (the king’s) enemies. Sabb. 34
<sup>a</sup> זונות מפַרְכְּסוֹת זו את זו וכ' harlots paint one another, how much the more must scholars (be regardful of one another’s honor)! B. Mets. IV, 12 (60
<sup>a</sup>) אין מְפַרְכְּסִין לא את האדם וכ' (Y. ed. a. Mish. Nap. מְפַרְקְסִין) you must not give a deceptive appearance to a human being (slave to be sold) or to a beast or to vessels, v. פִּירְכּוּס I. Y. ib. IV, end, 9
<sup>d</sup> מהו אין מפרקסין … צור גרמך what is meant by ‘you must not paint (a slave)’? You must not tell him, paint thyself (to appear younger); a. e.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="Q01863">
<head-word>פִּרִכֵּס</head-word>
<hw-number>II</hw-number>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (preced.) [
<italic>to rub, grind</italic>,] 
<italic>to move convulsively, to struggle, kick</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ohol. I, 6 הותזו … שמְפַרְכְּסִים וכ' if their heads have been cut off, they are unclean (as corpses), although they still move convulsively; כגון זנב … שמְפַרְכֶּכֶת like the tail of the lizzard which moves (after being separated); Tosef. ib. II, 1. Y. Sot. IX, beg. 23

<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to split, break</italic>, esp. (v. 
<xref rid="B01100">בָּצַע</xref>) 
<italic>to break bread and say grace</italic>.</definition>
<notes> R. Hash. 29
<sup>b</sup> לא יִפְרוֹס אדם פרוסה וכ' a person should not break bread and say grace for his guests, unless he dines with them אבל פּוֹרֵס הוא לבניו וכ' but he may do so for his children and his household in order to train them in religious practice. Pes. 37
<sup>a</sup>; Men. 78
<sup>b</sup> (expl. מצה הינא) כל שפּוֹרְסָהּ ואין וכ' when he breaks it apart, and no cords (of unbaked dough) can be drawn out of it; a. e.—Part. pass. פָּרוּס; f. פְּרוּסָה; 
<plural-form>pl. פְּרוּסִים, פְּרוּסִין; פְּרוּסוֹת</plural-form>. Lev. R. s. 34 (ref. to פָּרֹס, Is. LVIII, 7) הלא תִפְרוֹשׂ … פָרוּס כבר היא פ' וכ' it does not read, ‘behold, thou shalt break’, but, ‘behold broken’; it (thy bread) is broken for thee, for from the beginning of the year it is decreed &c. Y. Dem. I, 21
<sup>d</sup> bot. בפ' when it is a broken piece of an eatable, opp. שלם. Y. Ber. VI, 10
<sup>b</sup> bot. פ' של חטים (sub. פת) a broken loaf of wheat bread; a. fr.—V. פְּרוּס, פְּרוּסָה.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (cmp. פָּרַץ) 
<italic>to break through</italic>; part. pass.</definition>
<notes> as ab. 
<italic>open, plain</italic>. Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. V, 4, v. סַוָּאר.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to spread</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Meg. III, 3 (28
<sup>a</sup>) ואין פּוֹרְשִׂין לתוכו מצודות nor dare you spread traps leading into it (the synagogue in ruins). Yoma III, 4 פָּרְסוּ סדין וכ' (Y. ed. פָּרְשׂוּ), v. סָדִין. Num. R. s. 11 הכהנים פּוֹרְשִׂים את כפיהם the priests spread their hands (when blessing). Ex. R. s. 42 אחז … ופ' הקב"ה וכ' he (Moses) took hold of the divine throne, and the Lord spread his cloak over him. Ib. (ref. to פּ֗ר̇ש̇ז̇, Job XXVI, 9) פ̇' ר̇חום ש̇די ז̇יו וכ' the Merciful Almighty spread the splendor of his cloud over him; ib. s. 41 פ' והגין עליו הקב"ה the Lord spread (his cloak) over him and protected him; a. fr.—Deut. R. s. 5 היה פוֹרֵשׂ דיאטגמא וכ' (not דאטגמא) he spread (published) a decree wherever he conquered &c.—Part. pass. as ab. Ab. III, 16, v. מְצוּדָה; a. e.—פ' על שמע (interch. with פ' את שמע) 
<italic>to spread a cloak over the head for the recitation of the prayers preceding the Shmʿa</italic> (Ḳaddish and Bar’khu), esp. 
<italic>to recite the prayers &c. for the benefit of those who have come too late for the regular service</italic> (cmp. Ber. 51
<sup>a</sup> פריס סודרא, quot. in next w.). Meg. IV, 3 (23
<sup>b</sup>) אין פורסין על שמע וכ' (Mish. ed. את; Mish. Pes. פורשין, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 90) the prayers for the Shmʿa are not read aloud … with less than two persons; [Rashi: 
<italic>to divide</italic> the Sh’ma (v. supra), i.e. to read parts of the prayers preceding the Shmʿa;] Y. ib. IV, 75
<sup>a</sup> bot. פורסין את שמע. Ib. IV, 5 המפטיר … פורס וכ', v. פָּטַר. Ib. 6. Lev. R. s. 23 א"ל פְּרוֹס על שמע פ' they said to him, recite the prayers for the Shmʿa; he did; Cant. R. to II, 2 (mixed dict.) פְּרוֹס לן את שמע פרוס לון (read: פָּרֵיס); a. fr.</notes></sense></senses>

<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>

<definition>

<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (denom. of פַּרְסָה) 
<italic>to part the foot, to have a parted hoof</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sifra Sh’mini, ch. V, Par. 4 משוסע, חזיר מפריס the swine parts its foot and is cloven-footed. Ḥull. 59
<sup>a</sup> אין לך דבר שמפריס פרסה וכ' there is no animal that parts its foot and yet is unclean, except swine; a. e.—Ib. 51
<sup>b</sup> ה' ע"ג קרקע the animal, after its fall, in attempting to rise made an impression of its parted feet on the ground (an evidence of its spine’s being unaffected).—Trnsf. 
<italic>to show the cloven foot</italic> (like swine, as if saying, ‘I am clean’, v. Lev. R. s. 13, end), 
<italic>to pretend piety</italic>. Gen. R. s. 22 יצא כמפריס וכמרמה וכ' (some ed. מפרים, corr. acc.) he went forth like a hypocrite and as one deceiving his Creator; (Yalk. ib. 38; Lev. R. s. 10 כמַעֲרִים, v. עָרַם II).</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>פֵּירֵס, פֵּירֵשׂ</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to spread</italic>.</definition>

<sup>a</sup> פרשו; Yalk. Ex. 372; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to put a wrap on</italic>, only in פֵּירְסָה נדה

<entry id="Q01911">
<head-word>פְּרָס</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (פָּרַס) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>part, half</italic>, v. 
<xref rid="Q01699">פְּרוּס</xref>.</definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>a piece</italic>, esp. 
<italic>a certain quantity of bread</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Neg. XIII, 9 כדי אכילת פ' פת חטין וכ' as much time as is required for eating a piece, that is, a piece of wheat bread &c. Ib. 10. Tosef. ib. VII, 10 וכמה הוא פ' חצי וכ' and how much is a 
<italic>p’ras</italic>? Half a loaf, of which three make a Kab; Tosef. Mikv. VII (VIII), 6; Erub. 83
<sup>a</sup>; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. פְּרָסִים;</plural-form>
<italic>Du.</italic> פְּרָסַיִים. Y. Sabb. I, 2
<sup>b</sup> bot. אכילת פ' eating two 
<italic>p’rasim</italic> (with interruption); ib. כמה זתים בכמה פ' several olive sizes of eatables eaten within a time required for eating several pieces; Y. Hor. III, 47
<sup>b</sup> bot.—Trnsf. 
<italic>the fare received by members of a household</italic>, or 
<italic>by slaves</italic>. Erub. 72
<sup>b</sup> במקבלי פ' שנו the Mishnah speaking of brothers eating at their father’s table means those receiving, each his separate fare, at the hands of their father. Ib. 73
<sup>a</sup> מי שיש לו … מקבלות פ' וכ' if a man has five wives (occupying separate dwellings in one court) receiving their fare at the hands of their husband, and five slaves receiving &c. Y. Taan. I, beg. 63
<sup>c</sup> הוא תובע פְּרָסוֹ ממנו he (the slave) begs him for his fare; (ib. פרנסתו). Ib. סמוך לפרסו near the period when his fare is due. Ab. I, 3, v. עֶבֶד; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>P’ras</italic>, half a Maneh (מָנֶה).</definition>
<notes> Eduy. III, 3 מנה ופ' each weighing one Maneh and a half. Peah VIII, 5; a. fr.—מנה בן פ', v. מָנֶה.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition>
<italic>P’ras, half the length of a furrow</italic> (v. infra); בית (ה)פ' 
<italic>an area of a square P’ras</italic>, esp. 
<italic>a field, of a square P’ras, declared unclean on account of crushed bones carried over it from a ploughed grave</italic>.</definition>
<notes> M. Kat. 5
<sup>b</sup> החורש את הקבר הרי הוא עושה בית פ' וכמה הוא עושה חצי מענה וכ' Ms. M. a. Rashi (ed. מלא מענה, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) he who ploughs over a grave, makes a 
<italic>beth-p’ras</italic> (an unclean field), and how much of it does he make unclean? Half the length of a furrow of one hundred cubits; Ohol. XVII, 1 החורש … עושה בית פ' … מאה אמה בית ארבעה סאים he who ploughs &c.; how far does he make it unclean? (Half) the size of a furrow of a hundred cubits (in all directions), which is a square of the capacity of four S’ahs of seed; Nidd. 57
<sup>a</sup>; Tosef. Ohol. XVII, 1. Ohol. XVII, 2 בית פ' עושה בית פ' an unclean field may create another unclean field (if the plough passes over and beyond it). Tosef. ib. XVII, 4 אבל עולה הוא כמדת הפ' (read: במדת; R. S. to Ohol. XVII, 3 כמדת בית הפ') but it is counted in so as to complete the measure of a 
<italic>beth-p’ras</italic>; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. בית פְּרָסוֹת</plural-form>. Ohol. XVIII, 2 (M. Kat. 5
<sup>b</sup> בית פרס). [Maim. explains בית הפ', by ref. to פָּרַס 
<italic>to extend, the area of extension</italic>; Rashi, by ref. to פָּרַס 
<italic>to break, an area of bone splinters</italic>.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to uncover</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ib. (ref. to Lev. XXI, 10) [read:] אילו אמר ראש לא יפרע ובגד לא יפרוס יכול לא יִפְרַע ולא יפרום של סוטה ת"ל ראשו if the text read, the head … and the garment …, I might have thought it meant, he shall not uncover the head &c., in the sense in which

<sup>a</sup> פְּרַע להן בית השחיטה uncover the place of cutting for them (show them that the animal has been cut according to the ritual); a. e.—Part. pass. פָּרוּעַ; f. פְּרוּעָה;

<italic>to uncover one’s self</italic> for a human need. Yoma 77
<sup>a</sup> (ref. to Ez. VIII, 16) שהיו פורעין עצמן והיו … כלפי מטה (מטה euphem. for מעלה) they uncovered themselves and committed a nuisance towards heaven; Kidd. 72

<sense>
<number>—3)</number>

<italic>to uncover the corona, to split the membrane and pull it down</italic>.</definition>

<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition> [
<italic>to solve a connection</italic> (Lat. solvo; cmp. לָוָה),] 
<italic>a</italic>) 
<italic>to pay a debt</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Bath. 5
<sup>a</sup> הקובע … פְּרַעְתִּיךָ בתוך זמני וכ' if a person fixes a time (in a note) for his neighbor, and the latter says, I have paid thee within the term assigned to me, he is disbelieved (he is not admitted to an oath); ולואי שיפרע בזמנו (for we say,) would that a man paid his debt when it is due! Ib. 6
<sup>a</sup> כאומר לא פָרַעְתִּי דמי, v. לָוָה; a. v. fr.—Part. pass. as ab. Keth. 19

<italic>b</italic>) פ' מן 
<italic>to settle with; to punish</italic>. Num. R. s. 11 כשפ' הקב"ה … לא פ' אלא יחידי when the Lord punished the generation of the flood, he punished singlehanded (not through several angels). B. Mets. IV, 2 מי שפ' מאנשי … הוא עתיד להִפָּרַע וכ' he who punished the men of the generation of …, will punish him who does not stand by his word (although the court cannot compel him); Tosef. ib. III, 14; B. Mets. 47
<sup>b</sup>, sq. לִפָּרַע וכ'. Ex. R. s. 10, beg. Cant. R. to VIII, 14 אין הקב"ה פורע מֵאוּמָּה וכ' the Lord punishes no nation here below before degrading its genius above; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses>

<entry id="Q01968">
<head-word>פָּרַץ</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to break through, make a breach, invade</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Pes. 56
<sup>a</sup> פּוֹרְצִין פרצות וכ' made breaches in the fences of their gardens &c.; (Tosef. ib. II (III), 21 פותחין גינותיהם וכ'); Men. 71
<sup>a</sup>. Ber. 63
<sup>a</sup> כבר גדרת … יכול לִפְרוֹץ having once fenced in, thou canst not tear down, i.e. having once approved, you cannot now find fault. Y. Snh. I, 19
<sup>c</sup> top, v. פּוּץ. Gen. R. s. 85 (ref. to Gen. XXXVIII, 29) כל הפּוֹרְצִים ממך וכ' all conquerors shall rise from thee (Judah). Yalk. Mic. 551 פָּרַצְתִּי גדרו של עולם מפני יעקב I broke down the fence of the world (reversed the natural order of things) for the sake of Jacob (making his cattle extremely fecund); ולע"ל אני פורץ אותו לבניו and in the days to come I shall do so to his children. B. Kam. 60
<sup>b</sup> מלך פּוֹרֵץ … דרך the king may break through fences to pave a way for his army. Koh. R. to IX, 11 (ref. to Job I, 10) פ' גדרו של עולם וכ' his cattle reversed the order of things &c. Y. Ab. Zar. II, 41
<sup>a</sup> top לא פָרַצְתָּ גדירן וכ' thou hast not torn down the fence of the scholars (not transgressed their law); Gen. R. s. 79, v. גָּדֵיר. Lev. R. s. 26, v. גֶּדֶר I; a. fr.—Part. pass. פָּרוּץ; f. פְּרוּצָה; 
<plural-form>pl. פְּרוּצִים, פְּרוּצִין; פְּרוּצוֹת</plural-form>. Kil. IV, 4 העומד מרובה על הפ' the unimpaired portion of the fence is larger than the ruined part, v. עָמַד II. Y. Sabb. X, 12
<sup>c</sup> top קופה פ' a bin which has been broken into (some of the contents of which has been taken); a. fr.—[Peah VII, 1 בצד הפרוצה Y. ed., v. פִּרְצָה.]</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (sub. גדר) 
<italic>to be lawless, unrestrained, dissolute</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Keth. I, 25
<sup>a</sup> bot. שלא יִפְרְצוּ … בזימה in order that the daughters of Israel be not made heedless of chaste conduct (v. infra); a. e.—
<italic>Part. pass</italic>. as ab. 
<italic>dissolute, bold</italic>. Ib. מפני פ' אחד because there might be one dissolute man (who may go to the expense of marriage for the sake of his gratification, with the intention of charging his bride with faithlessness afterwards). Cant. R. to IV, 12 לא נמצא בהן אחד פ' בעיוה not one of them was of immoral conduct; Lev. R. s. 32 פְּרוּץ ערוה. Gitt. 46
<sup>a</sup> שלא יהו בנות … פ' וכ' that the daughters of Israel may not be loose in moral conduct or in vows (v. supra). Gen. R. s. 70 (ref. to Gen. XXIX, 21) אפי' אדם פ' אינו וכ' even the most shameless man would not use such language. Sot. 7
<sup>a</sup> אבל פ' but if they are known to be of dissolute habits, opp. כשרין. Keth. 2
<sup>b</sup>, sq. משום פ' on account of loose women, opp. צנועות; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to spread, increase</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. 13
<sup>a</sup>; Tosef. ib. I, 14 עד היכן פָּרְצָה טהרה וכ' how far the observance of levitical cleanness has spread in Israel!; a. e.</notes></sense></senses>

<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>

<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be broken through, torn down</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tosef. Kil. III, 3 מחיצת הכרם שנִפְרְצָה if the partition of a vineyard has come down; גדרה ונ' if he repaired it, and it came down again. Erub. IX, 2 חצר גדולה שנפרצה לקטנה if the partition between a large court and a smaller one has been broken into. Yalk. Ez. 352 a good shepherd שנ' גדר צאנו the fold of whose flock was broken into; (Ruth R. introd. שנפלה). גדר Tanḥ. Bal. 13 ראה שישראל נִפְרָצִים שם he (Balak) saw that the Israelites would be broken into (sustain a great loss) there; Num. R. s. 20 שיש פרצים (corr. acc.). Ab. d’R. N. ch. V ונִפְרְצוּ וכ', v. פִּרְצָה; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>

<italic>to be unrestrained, dissolute</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tanḥ. Vayera 9 לפי שנפרצו מעשיהם בזנות because their doings were unrestrained in matters of sexual morality; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be spread, increased</italic>.</definition>

<sense>
<number>—4)</number>

<italic>to be broken off, severed</italic>.</definition>

<italic>to be defiant</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tosef. Macc. V (IV), 13 אפי' עומד ומַפְרִיץ וכ' even if he stands up defiantly (saying, he did not mind more lashes), you dare not add &c.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>

<senses>
<sense>
<definition>

<plural-form>Pl. פַּרְצוּפִים, פַּרְצוּפִין, פַּרְצוּפוֹת</plural-form>. Ib. שני פ'; Tosef. Shek. III, 14 שתי פ' (fem.). Ab. Zar. 42

<entry id="Q01980">

<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) 
<italic>to break, separate; to untie, loosen; to unload</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. 138
<sup>a</sup> וילון … ומותר לפוֹרְקוֹ it is permitted (on the Sabbath) to stretch a curtain and also to untie (remove) it. Ib.
<sup>b</sup> top. Y. Shebi. III, beg. 34
<sup>c</sup> לא יִפְרוֹק וכ', v. מִשְׁפֶּלֶת. [Ib. לא יַפְרִיק 
<italic>Hif.</italic>, v. infra.] Cant. R. to I, 5 טוענת ופוֹרֶקֶת she loads (becomes pregnant) and unloads (delivers); a. fr.—Trnsf. 
<italic>to redeem, deliver</italic>. Gen. R. s. 44 אני פוֹרְקָן I shall redeem them; a. e.—פ' עול 
<italic>to untie the yoke, cast off an obligation</italic>. Ab. III, 5, v. עוֹל. Tosef. Sot. XIV, 4 פָּרְקוּ מהם עול וכ' they cast off the heavenly yoke, and made flesh and blood rule over them; a. fr.—Tanḥ. Ḥuck. 25 אינן פּוֹרְקִין יראה they do not cast off the fear (of having lost the divine grace through their sins); Yalk. Num. 765 אין פורקין יראה מהם; Num. R. s. 19 אין פּוֹרְקִים ביראה (corr. acc.).—Part. pass. פָּרוּק; f. פְּרוּקָה; 
<plural-form>pl. פְּרוּקִים, פְּרוּקִין; פְּרוּקוֹת</plural-form>. Y. B. Kam. III, 3
<sup>d</sup> אחד פ' ואחד טעון וכ' if (on meeting on the road) one animal is without a load, and the other is laden, the unladen must make room for the laden; היו שניהן … פ' if both are laden or both unladen. Ib. שתיהן פ' if both wagons are without a load; a. fr.—Esp. 
<italic>to help to unload an animal broken down under its burden</italic> (Ex. XXIII, 5). B. Mets. II, 10 מצוה … לִפְרוֹק, v. טָעַן II. Ib. אם רצונך לפרוק פְּרוֹק if thou desirest to unload, do so (without my assistance); a. fr.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>פֵּירֵק</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to sever, strip; to take off, release; to take apart</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Shebi. II, 2 מְפָרְקִין you may release (trees in the Sabbatical year); Y. ib. 33
<sup>d</sup> top מפ' בעלין ‘release’ refers to (a too luxuriant growth of) leaves. Ukts. II, 5 התחיל לְפָרֵק when he has begun to strip (vegetables). Tosef. ib. II, 13 התחיל לפרק באגוזים when he has begun to strip nuts (of their burrs). Sabb. 88
<sup>a</sup> ירדו … ופֵירְקוּם one hundred and twenty myriads of angels of destruction came down and took them (the crowns) off their heads. Ib. בחורב … פֵּרְקוּ (Rashi פירקו) at Horeb they loaded (angels put crowns on their heads), and at Horeb they unloaded (angels took their crowns off). Men. 8
<sup>a</sup>; 9
<sup>b</sup> עד שלא פֵרְקָהּ before he took it (the pile of the show bread) apart. Y. Yoma I, 38
<sup>c</sup> top מעמירו ומְפָרְקוֹ put it (the Tabernacle) up and broke it up again; העמידו ולא פירקו put it up and did not break it up again; Num. R. s. 13, beg.; Sifra Tsav, Milluim, Par. 1 end.—Y. M. Kat. I, 80
<sup>b</sup> bot. מְפָרְקִין את המנעול וכ' you may take the shoe off the block. Y. Ab. Zar. III, 43
<sup>b</sup>, v. פַּצִּים; a. fr.—Sabb. 95
<sup>a</sup> חולב חייב משום מפרק one milking (on the Sabbath) is guilty of an act resembling unloading; Keth. 60
<sup>a</sup> יונק מפרק כלאחר יד releasing the cow by sucking is unloading in an unusual way (v. 
<pgbrk id="pg1239" />אַחַר). Lev. R. s. 13 עמד ופֵרְקוּם לישראל he rose and took them off the back of the gentiles, and put them on Israel.—Sabb. 156
<sup>a</sup> לְפָרֵק to take food from before one animal and place it before another, Rashi; [Tosaf.: to empty from vessel to vessel in order to procure a thorough mixture; other defin., v. Ar. s. v.].—
<italic>Part. pass</italic>. מְפוֹרָק 
<italic>a</italic>) 
<italic>unloaded</italic>. B. Mets. 33
<sup>a</sup> (ref. to Ex. l. c.) ‘under its burden’, ולא מפ' but not when it is unloaded (and the owner requires assistance to load it again). Ib. לא מפ' בחנם when it is unloaded, one need not assist in loading without remuneration.—
<italic>b</italic>) 
<italic>taken apart, broken up</italic>. Tanḥ. P’kudé 11 והיה מונח ומפ' וכ' and it (the Tabernacle) lay in parts (uncombined) during &c.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>

<sup>b</sup> איבריה מתפרקין הימנה she feels as tho’ her limbs were dropping off. Yalk. Num. 708 תהא מִתְפָּרֶקֶת איברים איברים she shall lose limb after limb; Num. R. s. 9 מתרפקת (corr. acc.); a. e.—[Yalk. Cant. 986 מתפרקות some ed., read: מתרפקות, v. רָפַק.]</notes></sense></senses></binyan>

<sup>a</sup> על כל פ' ופ' at every important epoch. Ib. 43
<sup>a</sup> top שהגיעו לפִרְקָן וכ' who have reached puberty but not the legal age (prematurely developed). Tosef. R. Hash. I, 12 פ' שעורים the season of the barley crop; פ' גשמים the rainy season. Ib. הראה לי את פִּרְקִי show me my time (when I am to die); a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. פְּרָקִים;</plural-form> constr. פִּרְקֵי, פִּי'. R. Hash. 35

<sup>a</sup> שני פ' הראשונים the two beginning periods (shortly before the beginning of the Sabbatical year, and before the beginning of the new Sabbatical period); ib. III, end, 34
<sup>d</sup>. Y. Shek. III, beg. 47
<sup>b</sup> פירקי לידה the seasons when animals give birth. Gen. R. s. 70, a. e. נשיקה של פ' the kiss on meeting after a period of separation; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (of writings) 
<italic>section, chapter</italic>.</definition>
<notes> R. Hash. 30
<sup>b</sup> מפני שחוזר וכופל את הפ' because in that case he would have to recite the same psalm again on the same day. Ber. 14
<sup>a</sup> בין פ' לפ' פוסק וכ' between one section (of the Hallel) and another he may interrupt himself, but in the middle of a section he must not do so. Ab. VI הלומד … פ' אחד וכ' he that learns from his neighbor one chapter or one 
<italic>halakhah</italic>. Erub. 54
<sup>b</sup> ושנה לו משה פִּירְקוֹ Moses taught him (Aaron) his lesson; ושנה להם … פִּירְקָן taught them their lesson; a. v. fr.—

<pgbrk id="pg1240" />to extend a greeting &c. Ib. 2 אלו הן בין הפ' these are the pauses between the sections: between the first and the second benediction (preceding the Sh’mʿa) &c. Ḥag. 13
<sup>a</sup> ראשי פ' the headings of chapters (or subjects, leading words). R. Hash. 31
<sup>a</sup> מה ראה ר"ע לחלק בין הפ' הללו Ms. M. (ed. ראו חכמים) what reason had R. ʿA. to make a distinction between these psalms (by referring six of them to past events and the seventh to the hereafter)?; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>link, limb, joint</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ḥull. 106
<sup>a</sup> sq. נטילת ידים לחולין עד הפ' וכ' washing of hands for secular food must be done up to the (second) joint (of the fingers), for T’rumah to the (third) joint; קידוש … עד הפ' sanctification of hands (and feet) up to the joint (of the hand); Arakh. 19
<sup>b</sup>; Tosef. Yad. II, 1; Yad. II, 3; Y. Ber. VIII, 12
<sup>a</sup>. Ḥull. X, 4 מן הפ' של ארכובה וכ' from the joint of the knee to the shoulder-blade of the forefoot. Ib. הפ' של לחי the joint of the jawbone. Sifra Tsav, Milluim, Par. 1 פ' האמצעי the middle joint (of the thumb); a. fr.—Pl. as ab. Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. III, 2, v. מִסְפֶּרֶת. Deut. R. s. 3 beg. מנורה שעשויה פ' פ' a candlestick made of separable links (v. חוּלְיָא I). Ab. Zar. 43
<sup>a</sup> בין פְּרָקָיו, expl. בין פִּרְקֵי צואר between the joints of its neck. Y. Ber. l. c. bot. (שולחן) של פ' a table that can be taken apart; a. fr.</notes></sense>

<senses>

<notes /></sense></senses>

<sense>
<definition>

<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הֵפֵר, הֵיפֵר</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to break, destroy; to thwart</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ab. III, 11 המֵפֵר בריתו וכ' he that breaks the Abrahamitic covenant (omits or effaces circumcision, v. מָשַׁךְ). Gen. R. s. 98 (play on פֹּרָת, Gen. XLIX, 22) בן שה' לאחיו the son that broke (faith) with his brothers; ib. שהֵפֵירוּ לו אחיו to whom his brothers were faithless; ib. שה' לאדונתו, v. אֲדוֹנָה. Ib. s. 16 (play on פְּרָת, Gen. II, 14) פרת שהֵפֵירָה והצירה לבניו Edom (Rome) is called P’rath, because she broke faith with, and distressed his (God’s) children (Var. לפניו); שאני עתיד להָפֵר לה because I (the Lord) shall in the end thwart her plans; Yalk. ib. 22; a. fr.—Esp. 
<italic>to make void; to disallow a vow</italic> (Num. XXX, 2-16). Ned. X, 1 אביה ובעלה מְפִירִין וכ' both her father and her husband must declare her vow void; ה' האב וכ' if only the father protested, and the husband did not. Ib. 2 הבעל מֵפֵר בבגר וכ' in the case of an adult the husband has the right of disallowing, but not the father. Ib. 4 אינו יכול להָפֵר he has no power to disallow her vows. Ib. 5 יָפֵר he has the power &c. Ib. 72
<sup>a</sup>, a. e. אין הבעל מֵיפֵר בקודמין the husband cannot invalidate vows made before marriage. Ib. XI, 12 (90
<sup>b</sup>) יָפֵר (ל)חלקי he may invalidate her vow for his share (as far as it concerns him). Ib. 7 איני יודע שוש מפירין I did not know that there are invalidating powers (vested in the husband); a. v. fr.—Part. pass. מוּפָר; 
<plural-form>pl. מוּפָרִין</plural-form>. Ib. X, 1 אינו מ' her vow is not made void. Ib. 4 כל נדרים … הרי הן מ' whatever vows thou mayest have made in my house, shall be void. Ib. 77
<sup>b</sup> מ' ליכי thy vow is void; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<senses>
<sense>

<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> (neut. verb) 
<italic>to go away, go aside, depart; to keep off</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Yoma I, 5 הוא פוֹרֵשׁ … פּוֹרְשִׁין וכ' he turned aside and wept, and so did they. Y. Keth. I, 25
<sup>d</sup> bot. ראו אותו פורש מציפורין they saw him come out of Sepphoris (so that he is presumably an inhabitant 
<pgbrk id="pg1242" />of Sepphoris); פירש מן הבתים they saw him leave one of the houses of Sepphoris. Num. R. s. 9 את פָּרַשְׁתְּ מדרך וכ' thou didst depart from the way (disregard the customs) of Israel’s daughters. Zeb. 113
<sup>a</sup> (play on פרשה, Num. XIX, 5) מקים שפּוֹרֶשֶׁת למיתה וכ' there where she departs for death, she shall be burnt. Y. M. Kat. I, 80
<sup>b</sup> bot. (ref. to Lev. XIII, 45) כדי שתהא טומאה … פְּרוֹשׁ that the uncleanness itself may cry out …, ‘keep off’; Y. Maas. Sh. V, beg. 55
<sup>d</sup>; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to pass, cross</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Yalk. Prov. 946; Yalk. Num. 738 הספינות פּוֹרְשׁוֹת בים the ships make their way through the sea.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition> (act. verb) 
<italic>to separate, keep off</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Num. R. s. 10 כשם שאדם פירש את עצמו וכ' as a person keeps himself away (abstains) from the fruits of Orlah, so will those who misbehave towards their handmaids, be separated from the virtuous on the day of judgment.; a. fr.—Part. pass. פָּרוּשׁ, q. v.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition> (cmp. פָּרַט) 
<italic>to single out, specify, speak distinctly</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ib. (expl. יַפְלִא, Num. VI, 2) כשיִפְרוֹשׁ לנדור וכ' when he speaks out his vow, to the exclusion of him who thinks it in his heart; a. fr.—Sifré Num. 24 עד שיפרוש לך … כדרך שפירש וכ' (Yalk. ib. 710 שיפרוט … שפרט), v. פָּרַט.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִפְרַשׁ</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be separated, kept away</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Lev. R. s. 22 והן נִפְרָשִׁים מעבודה זרה and thus they will be kept away from idolatrous worship; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>פֵּירֵשׁ</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> (neut. verb) (neut. verb) 
<italic>to depart, withdraw; to abstain</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Snh. 82
<sup>b</sup> היה לו … לפרוש ולא פי' Zimri might have withdrawn (from the woman), but he did not. Ib.
<sup>a</sup> אם פ' וכ' if Z. had withdrawn, and Phineas had slain him &c. Pes. 87
<sup>b</sup> פ' מן האשה withdrew from contact with his wife. Gen. R. s. 20 שפֵּירְשָׁה חיה מאדם that Eve was separated from Adam.—Sabb. 86
<sup>b</sup> פירשה מן האיש the semen issued from a man.—Pes. 49
<sup>b</sup> שנה ופ' קשה וכ' he that studied and gave it up, is the worst of all (in hostility to scholars); a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to go on a voyage; to cross the ocean</italic> (cmp. פָּלַג 
<italic>Hif.</italic>).</definition>
<notes> Y. M. Kat. III, beg. 81
<sup>c</sup> אסור לפָרֵשׁ לים הגדול it is forbidden to start on a sea voyage (during the festive week). Y. Yeb. XVI, 15
<sup>d</sup> top עשיתי מְפָרֵשׁ וכ' I was crossing &c. Y. Meg. II, 73
<sup>b</sup> top מְפָרְשֵׁי ימים voyagers on the sea; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition> (act. verb) 
<italic>to separate</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 22 אילו רצה המלך פֵּירְשָׁן ולא רצה המלך לפָרְשָׁן if the king desired it, he would separate them (the fighters), but the king does not wish to separate them; Yalk. ib. 38.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to specify, express clearly</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ib. א"א לפה לפָרְשוֹ no mouth can express it. Men. 91
<sup>a</sup> דמְפָרֵשׁ when he (in making his vow) specified (‘sheep’ or ‘cattle’), opp. בסתמא. Gen. R. s. 6 אנשי … פֵּירְשׁוּ אותו the men of the Great Assembly said it plainly. Snh. VII, 5 עד שיְפָרֵשׁ השם until he mentions the Name expressly (uses the Tetragrammaton), opp. כִּינּוּי. Gitt. 36
<sup>a</sup> שיהו עדים מְפָרְשִׁין שמותיהן that witnesses must sign their full names; a. fr.—Part. pass. מְפוֹרָשׁ, f. מְפוֹרֶשֶׁת; 
<plural-form>pl. מְפוֹרָשִׁים, מְפוֹרָשִׁין; מְפוֹרָשׁוֹת</plural-form>. B. Kam. 54
<sup>b</sup>, a. fr. מה הפרט מפ', v. פְּרָט. B. Mets. 94
<sup>b</sup> שלישית בשואל מפ' that the third paragraph treats of a borrower, is explicitly stated (Ex. XXII, 13). Sot. 38
<sup>a</sup>, a. fr. שם המפ' the special Name (the Tetragrammaton), v. supra. Zeb. 53
<sup>a</sup>, v. סָתַם. Ḥag. 22
<sup>b</sup> ומה סתומות … מפ' וכ' if your undefined teachings are so well-founded, how much more your explicit teachings; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—5)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to explain, interpret, define</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ned. 2
<sup>b</sup> פתח … ומפרש ידות the Mishnah begins with 
<italic>kinnuyim</italic> …, and goes on explaining 
<italic>yadoth!</italic> Zeb. 13
<sup>a</sup> ואין לי לפרש and I am unable to explain (the reason of the distinction between receiving and sprinkling the blood); אני אֲפָרֵשׁ I shall explain it. Ned. 81
<sup>a</sup> דבר זה … ולא פֵירְשׁוּהוּ עד שפֵּירְשׁוֹ וכ' that question (Jer. IX, 11) was asked of prophets and scholars, and they could not explain it, until the Lord himself explained it (ib. 12). M. Kat. 16
<sup>b</sup>; Ber. 18
<sup>a</sup> לא פֵירְשׁוּ לך they did not interpret (the verse) to you; v. שָׁנָה I. Gen. R. s. 31 ולא פ' and did not explain (of what material the serpent was to be made); Y. R. Hash. III, end, 59
<sup>a</sup>; a. fr.—Part. pass. as ab. Meg. 3
<sup>a</sup>, a. e. (ref. to Neh. VIII, 8) מפ' זה תרגום 
<italic>m’forash</italic> means interpretation.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
